provenance.selectionRule: Use the Harness sidebar-workspace source and tests as the contract; VCP must not connect this reference to Workspace persistence, directory IPC, or session actions.

candidateStatus: source-only; complex injected workspace/session state is documented, no VCP consumer, capture, computed-style diff, or pixel parity claim
tree: div.root[wide|rail] > sectionHeader(search + options + add) + listArea(tree/search results) + browser-owned rename/delete dialogs + WorkspacePickFlow

aria.search: button aria-expanded controls wide-only search input; Escape/clear collapses empty query
aria.workspaceActions: localized add/view-options controls; Menu and Modal delegate their own ARIA
aria.rows: row components own session/workspace/menu semantics and native drag targets

ownership.business: injected workspace/session actions own create, rename, delete, archive, reorder, fork, open and remote search
ownership.search: browser owns sanitized draft, 250ms debounce and AbortController; unmount aborts in-flight search
ownership.dialogs: browser owns rename/delete transient state so row unmounts cannot settle stale dialogs
ownership.rail: sidebar owner supplies wide/expandSidebar; browser delays focus until the owner slide completes

vcpBoundary: Reference only; no VCP Workspace persistence, directory IPC, session navigation, drag/reorder, or sidebar consumer integration.
